rationale: Identity was properly verified using full name and ZIP, and the assistant correctly located the pending order with the Hiking Boots. However, two policy violations occurred: (1) The assistant incorrectly stated that no size 8 variants were available, despite the product tool showing an available size 8 synthetic, non‑waterproof option. This is unsupported by the tools. (2) The assistant executed the order modification without first obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation after stating the exact change; they said they would proceed and then made the change, which violates the requirement to confirm before any write. While the final modification and refund details were correct, these errors mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
